Originally published as `PaletteWoodsHole` as an R package. Hand-picked color palettes inspired by Woods Hole, Falmouth, and Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution. Eel Pond in winter, Siders Pond at sunset, the Shining Sea Bikeway, and more. This mode browses all **20 palettes** and gives you a copy-ready hex list for whichever one fits your figure.

```r
# install the source package
remotes::install_github("shu251/PaletteWoodsHole")
library(PaletteWoodsHole)
show_color(atlantis)   # scales::show_col() grid, as used in this package
```

## The palettes

```{r}
#| label: load-woods-hole
#| message: false
#| results: asis
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)

woods_hole <- read_csv("../data/woods-hole-palettes.csv")

swatch_html <- function(hex, cap = 8) {
  n <- length(hex)
  shown <- head(hex, cap)
  spans <- glue('<span class="mini-swatch" style="background:{shown}"></span>')
  out <- paste(spans, collapse = "")
  if (n > cap) out <- paste0(out, glue('<span class="palette-module-more">+{n - cap} more</span>'))
  out
}

gallery <- woods_hole |>
  arrange(palette, position) |>
  group_by(palette, display_name, description) |>
  summarise(
    n_colors = n(),
    swatches = swatch_html(hex),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(display_name)

cat(
  '<div class="palette-gallery">',
  glue_data(
    gallery,
    '<div class="palette-module">
  <h4>{display_name} <span class="palette-module-count">{n_colors} colors</span></h4>
  <p class="palette-module-desc">{description}</p>
  <div class="palette-module-swatches">{swatches}</div>
</div>'
  ),
  '</div>',
  sep = "\n"
)
```

## Use it

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
whData = FileAttachment("../data/woods-hole-palettes.csv").csv({typed: true})
whPaletteMeta = Array.from(
  d3.rollup(whData, v => v[0].display_name, d => d.palette),
  ([palette, display_name]) => ({palette, display_name})
).sort((a, b) => a.display_name.localeCompare(b.display_name))
whOptions = new Map(whPaletteMeta.map(d => [d.display_name, d.palette]))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof whChoiceLabel = Inputs.select(Array.from(whOptions.keys()), {label: "Palette", value: "Atlantis"})
whChoice = whOptions.get(whChoiceLabel)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
whFiltered = whData.filter(d => d.palette === whChoice).sort((a, b) => a.position - b.position)
whHexList = whFiltered.map(d => d.hex).join("\n")
whHexVector = 'c(' + whFiltered.map(d => `"${d.hex}"`).join(', ') + ')'
whHexSingleQuote = whFiltered.map(d => `'${d.hex}'`).join(', ')
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function whTextColor(hex) {
  const c = hex.replace("#", "");
  const r = parseInt(c.substring(0, 2), 16);
  const g = parseInt(c.substring(2, 4), 16);
  const b = parseInt(c.substring(4, 6), 16);
  const lum = (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) / 255;
  return lum > 0.6 ? "#241C1C" : "#FFFFFF";
}

html`<p style="color:#555;margin-bottom:.5rem;">${whFiltered.length ? whFiltered[0].description : ""}</p>
<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin:1rem 0 1.5rem;">
  ${whFiltered.map(d => html`<div class="color-chip" style="background:${d.hex};padding:12px;min-width:120px;min-height:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;color:${whTextColor(d.hex)}">
    <div style="font-weight:600;">${d.hex}</div>
  </div>`)}
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
whVectorCopyBtn = {
  const label = () => `Copy R vector (${whFiltered.length})`;
  const btn = html`<button class="swatch-copy-btn">${label()}</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(whHexVector).then(() => {
      btn.textContent = "Copied!";
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = label(); }, 1200);
    });
  };
  return btn;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
whListCopyBtn = {
  const label = () => `Copy hex list (${whFiltered.length})`;
  const btn = html`<button class="swatch-copy-btn swatch-copy-btn--secondary">${label()}</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(whHexList).then(() => {
      btn.textContent = "Copied!";
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = label(); }, 1200);
    });
  };
  return btn;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="margin-top:1.5rem;">
  <p style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.4rem;">1. Ready for <code>scale_fill_manual()</code></p>
  ${whVectorCopyBtn}
  <pre class="hex-list-block"><span class="hl-fu">c</span>(${whFiltered.map((d, i) => html`<span class="hl-st">"${d.hex}"</span>${i < whFiltered.length - 1 ? ", " : ""}`)})</pre>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="margin-top:1.25rem;">
  <p style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.4rem;">2. Or just the hex codes</p>
  ${whListCopyBtn}
  <pre class="hex-list-block">${whHexList}</pre>
</div>`
```

## Using a palette back in R

```{r}
#| eval: false
# straight from the package
library(PaletteWoodsHole)
scales::show_col(atlantis)

# or from this site's exported hex list, pasted in
my_pal <- c("#9dbabb", "#1b334b", "#cfbc9f", "#576f70", "#091a2a")
ggplot(mpg, aes(class, fill = class)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_pal)
```
